title: The Three-Year Agreement Begins
summary: Xiao Yan faces Nalan Yanran at the Misty Cloud Sect, watched by its disciples, the empire's great forces and Nalan Jie. First Elder Yun Leng tells him life and death are up to fate. Nalan Yanran opens with the Wind Spirit Fractal Sword, a Xuan Class Medium Rank Dou Skill, and the Misty Cloud Sect's Wind Afterimages. Xiao Yan drops his heavy black ruler, gains speed and answers with Octane Blast. Gu He, the Pill King, arrives and greets Jia Xing Tian, Fa Ma and Hai Bodong. Nalan Yanran shows that she is now a Da Dou Shi with Dou Qi Armour, and Xiao Yan matches her. They argue over the past, and at the end she uses her trump card while Xiao Yan forms the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.
events: Disciples and guests mock or wonder at Xiao Yan; Nalan Jie praises his bearing.
Yun Leng opens the duel: life and death are up to fate.
Nalan Yanran uses the Wind Spirit Fractal Sword.
Xiao Yan drops his black ruler and hits with Octane Blast; she counters with Wind Afterimages.
Gu He arrives and meets Jia Xing Tian, Fa Ma and Hai Bodong.
Nalan Yanran reveals she is a Da Dou Shi; Xiao Yan uses Dou Qi Armour too.
She says he is not qualified to be her man; he says he no longer hates her.
(In ep58 file) the crowd realises Yan Xiao is Xiao Yan; he fuses Heavenly Flame and Dou Qi into the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.
